statute.heading: §6714. Failure to meet disclosure requirements applicable to quid pro quo contributions

children.label: (a)
children.heading: Imposition of penalty
children.text: If an organization fails to meet the disclosure requirement of section 6115 with respect to a quid pro quo contribution, such organization shall pay a penalty of $10 for each contribution in respect of which the organization fails to make the required disclosure, except that the total penalty imposed by this subsection with respect to a particular fundraising event or mailing shall not exceed $5,000.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Reasonable cause exception
children.text: No penalty shall be imposed under this section with respect to any failure if it is shown that such failure is due to reasonable cause.

other_notes.heading: Codification
other_notes.text: Another section 6714 was renumbered section 6715 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section applicable to quid pro quo contributions made on or after Jan. 1, 1994, see section 13173(d) of Pub. L. 103–66, set out as a note under section 6115 of this title.
